authority: Roman Missal 1962 Ritus servandus; existing canonical AO source cues
approval: Every new or corrected SVG needs explicit user visual approval and original rights/provenance before activation.

illustrationContract.originalArtwork: Use prior approved 29 October monochrome currentColor silhouette family only as a stylistic reference; do not modify the six approved original files.
illustrationContract.format: True vector SVG with currentColor, transparent background, no embedded raster/font, no facial detail.
illustrationContract.roles: PRIEST gesture, not priest position or faithful posture. The underlying 1962 prayer and source rubrics remain authoritative.
illustrationContract.glyphReview: Verify exact hand/object positions at 32px and 390px, with background/color inversion; capture LIVE and MISSAL EN/FR.
illustrationContract.publication: RESEARCH_ONLY until exact user approval, license record, SVG hash and source-/cue-specific browser checks.

Major elevation pose
Looking toward an already elevated Host
